## Validation

Commands, environment, actual pass/fail/skip and limitations. Synthetic examples only; no private logs.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Implementation and relevant regression proof complete
- [ ] Security impact and trust boundaries reviewed
- [ ] Data/API compatibility and Arabic content preserved
- [ ] English docs, PROJECT_STATUS and CHANGELOG updated as relevant
- [ ] Rollback/recovery documented
- [ ] No secrets, personal conversations, models or private artifacts introduced
- [ ] Owner/operational approval gates respected

## Rollback and approvals

Identify schema/runtime/config transitions. Do not deploy or apply proposed SQL automatically.
